title: Fix AppShell Stats button active state missing dark mode variants
description:
In app-shell.tsx line 121, the Stats button active state uses light-only classes:

`className={cn(showStats && 'bg-primary-50 text-primary-700')}`

In dark mode, bg-primary-50 creates a pale light-colored badge against the dark toolbar header. Compare with keyboard-shortcuts-panel.tsx line 94 which correctly uses: 'bg-primary-50 text-primary-700 dark:bg-primary-900/30 dark:text-primary-300'.

Fix: Change to:
`className={cn(showStats && 'bg-primary-50 dark:bg-primary-900/30 text-primary-700 dark:text-primary-300')}`

This is a 1-line fix.
